title: RBI (Non-Banking Financial Companies — Responsible Business Conduct) Third Amendment Directions, 2026
description: <cite index="57-6,57-7,57-8">Notification No. DOR.MCS.REC.No.199/01-01-039/2026-27 (RBI/2026-27/230), effective 1 January 2027, amends the RBI NBFC Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 and lays out a framework for how debt is collected from borrowers.</cite>
